Steps 9 and 10 are complete. Here's a summary of what was done:

**Step 9 — Section sub-homepages** (commit `9aa71ba`):
- Complete rewrite of `[category]/index.astro` with per-section personality
- Newsletter: full-bleed masthead with "The Hangman Chronicles" as `<title>` and `<h1>`, oxblood accent, `№001` dispatch numbering
- Articles: clay accent, `A·01` catalog numbering, editorial list
- Reviews: gold accent, `R·01` numbering, **ruled ledger-table device** — three-column grid with right-aligned date column and prominent rules between rows
- All use dark-mode-aware `--sec-accent` CSS var

**Step 10 — Post pages + uniform pages** (commit `6b54f08`):
- `PostLayout`: Fraunces H1, Newsreader prose, mono dateline, breadcrumb nav back to section, dark-mode-aware `--post-accent` var per section, tag chips as Edition pill buttons. Cloudinary figures and OG meta intact.
- `PageHeader`: Updated to Edition tokens (Fraunces 400, mono subtitles, gold counts, 2px ruled border)
- `bylines/index.astro`, `archive/[...page].astro`, `topics/index.astro`, `topics/[tag].astro`: uniform Edition family treatment via updated PageHeader + token fixes
- `about.astro`, `contact.astro`: Edition-native mastheads; contact rendered as a ruled ledger `<dl>`

CI is green on both push and PR runs.
